covered.label: Bybanen (light rail) lines 1 and 2
covered.detail: All 33 stops on both lines, with live running times.

notCovered.label: Skyss buses
notCovered.detail: Not covered, even at a Bybanen stop that is also a bus stop or terminal.

notCovered.label: Trains at Bergen railway station
notCovered.detail: Bergen railway station is a separate building from any Bybanen stop and isn't in this app.

notes: Bergen busstasjon is the shared stop in the city centre where both lines call. Byparken and Kaigaten are each one line's own end of the line.
